key_idea: The unbounded gap is achieved by encoding the integrality gap between the fractional and integer vertex cover of the complete graph K_4 into a bin packing instance.
reason: The core idea of transferring a graph-theoretic integrality gap to a one-dimensional packing problem is highly surprising and conceptually elegant. However, realizing this idea requires dense technical bookkeeping, including intricate scalar encodings, multiple item species, and complex interval geometry, which heavily limits its structural simplicity.
recognized: The Unbounded Configuration Gap for Bin Packing (2024)
